duling and assignment engine is the strongest verified area: capability filtering, weighted scoring, quote-time placement, event-driven rescheduling and the decision log are covered by dedicated unit tests and by an integration flow that exercises the real
PostgreSQL pipeline, including the EXCLUDE constraint that prevents double-booking.
Authentication and ownership isolation are the second strongest area. Cross-tenant reads, updates and deletes return 404, unauthenticated calls return 401 and admin endpoi
nts enforce RBAC. This is both a demo-critical and a security-critical property.
No critical or high defect remains open. The eight defects found during the project are fixed and closed, and each fix is covered by a regression case. The five pending system
cases are manual UI checks (3D preview, print configuration, admin screens) and one SEPay sandbox check; they are scheduled for the final acceptance round and are not blockers for the demo.
Residual risk is concentrated in the out-of-scope areas: real pay
